note: MIU accuracy = exact full-string match of the gold hanzi within the engine's top-K candidate list, driven through the production PinyinAdapter one keystroke at a time. Top-5/10 collapse toward Top-1 because the engine exposes no n-best sentence list. Measured against the engine AS COMPILED: as of v1.4.0 the COMPOSE/ASSOCIATION/FUZZY/PREDICTION pipeline gates are hard-disabled consts (minimal-debug state) — only literal-syllable lookup + FST prefix completion survive, so multi-syllable sentence rows almost always miss. This is the intended pre-Phase-1 floor; flipping the COMPOSE gate is Phase-1 work and is expected to lift these numbers.
